System check for this event: the growth stage requires the control thermocouple, the tube pressure gauge and the exhaust O2 sensor; the tube pressure gauge and the exhaust O2 sensor are not installed, so the atmosphere cannot be verified with the installed sensors.

evidence.observation: Ramp tracked setpoint within ~1 °C throughout (749.4 vs 749.6 °C).
Growth hold settled to 749.4 °C after an overshoot to 760.7 °C at 2520 s that corrected itself.
Heater power in hold is 38–45%, a steady and plausible level after the overshoot.
Argon flow matches the 100 sccm setpoint (99.2–100.9).
Pressure gauge and exhaust O2 sensor are not installed, but the growth stage needs both to verify the atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure and exhaust O2 readings during growth (or a manual leak/O2 check) are needed to verify the atmosphere. The sample also has no characterization yet.
